-104.78900,38.82830.name: CNY Fertility Colorado
-104.78900,38.82830.desc: A fertility clinic reporting to the CDC's National ART Surveillance System. Medical director: Robert J. Kiltz, MD. A fertility clinic is where human embryos are made, selected and stored, and where assisted reproduction happens, like IVF, ICSI, egg and sperm donation, freezing embryos and eggs for later. Reporting is required of every US clinic performing assisted reproduction, under the Fertility Clinic Success Rate and Certification Act, so this is close to a complete register rather than a list of members. What it records is cycles started, which is not the same as children born.

-122.41920,37.77930.name: Johnson v. Monsanto — the first glyphosate verdict
-122.41920,37.77930.state: San Francisco — Superior Court of California
-122.41920,37.77930.desc: A California jury found in 2018 that glyphosate had contributed to a school groundskeeper’s cancer and that the manufacturer had failed to warn, and awarded damages later reduced on appeal. Thousands of claims followed and the reserves run to billions. Whatever one concludes about the science, the verdict is the reason herbicide-tolerance traits are now a financial exposure as well as a product, and the reason the industry is seeking statutory protection it lost in court.
